question: Can a securely pre-1578 physical print witness close the Zhao/Gexiang textual gate for the 若子時則上半時... half-Zi wording without overclaiming direct copying into Sanming 1578?

secure_readings: 若子時則上半時在夜半前屬昨日
下半時在夜半後屬今日
古曆每時以二小刻為始乃各繼以四大刻

direct_physical_collation.method: Direct visual collation of source-bound 360-dpi renders; OCR/text layer excluded from final glyph adjudication.

recension_comparison.zhengde_1520: 若子時則上半時在夜半前屬昨日 / 下半時在夜半後屬今日
recension_comparison.later_received_gexiang_cadal06054852: 子時之上一半在夜半前屬昨日 / 下一半在夜半後屬今日
recension_comparison.shendao_v11: 若子時則上半時在夜半前屬昨日 / 下半時在夜半後屬今日
recension_comparison.sanming_1578: 若子時則上半時在夜半前為昨日 / 下半時在夜半後屬今日
recension_comparison.finding: The 1520 Zhengde witness physically proves that the 若子時則上半時 construction existed inside the Gexiang transmission before Sanming 1578. It exactly matches the reviewed Shendao construction at this locus and differs from exact Sanming only by 屬昨日 versus 為昨日.
recension_comparison.later_cadal_variant_significance: The later received CADAL witness preserves a different but mechanically equivalent opening (子時之上一半...), proving recension variation within the Gexiang tradition; the later wording must not be projected backward onto all witnesses.

chronology_and_stemma.safe_claim: A 1520 printed Gexiang witness supplies a physical chronological antecedent for the hundred-ke / half-Zi rule and the closer 若子時則 wording. Direction of direct copying into Shendao or Sanming remains unresolved.

probe_metadata_firewall.issue: Those exploratory NLC892 workflows initially copied Pingtu 011907/011908 and Zhengde-15 edition identity into their manifests without proving cross-copy identity.
probe_metadata_firewall.repair: Their manifests are corrected in Batch 12DC to mark the NLC892 catalog/edition identity unresolved for that surrogate. Batch 12DC relies on NCL-06265 instead.
probe_metadata_firewall.rationale: The overbinding remained inside exploratory workflow manifests and was not promoted as a durable Matrix/source-registry/graph adjudication before this correction.

edges_supported: The existing Gexiang -> Sanming textual-ancestry candidate is now supported by a direct 1520 physical antecedent, while direct copying remains unproved.
unresolved_lineage_questions: Identify the exact carrier/common source behind the Sanming 1578 and Yueling 1589 十三後 / 雨水後四日 change-day fingerprint.
Identify the pre-1578 59/41 Nanjing/Datong numeric carrier at table level.
Identify the historically attested C-II-N -> whole-ke threshold/selection rule.
